{"consolidated_memory":"CONSOLIDATED: Data loss in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt — Four separate incidents

All incidents involve the same component (mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt, mobile sync side) and share a common signal and repro method, but have different root causes, fixes, and occasions.

SHARED CHARACTERISTICS:
- Component: mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt, mobile sync side
- Problem: data loss in offline cache
- Signal: local row missing after the next app launch
- Repro method: force stop app with unsynced edits

INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-27]:
- Trigger: occurred only on staging read replica
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: added composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #5466, branch fix/data-loss-1
- Outcome: error rate dropped from 6.5% to under 1 per 10,000

INCIDENT 2 [2026-04-06]:
- Trigger: occurred only for jobs scheduled across midnight boundary
- Root cause: schema drift between migration and model
- Fix: regenerated model from migration and pinned checksum
- PR #5531, branch fix/data-loss-2
- Outcome: alert stayed quiet for 37 consecutive days

INCIDENT 3 [2026-04-19]:
- Trigger: occurred only for sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched relation in single query
- PR #6012, branch fix/data-loss-3
- Outcome: cold start performance improved 44%, dropped to 443 ms

INCIDENT 4 [2026-05-15]:
- Trigger: occurred only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: config loader reading wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #6474, branch fix/data-loss-4
- Outcome: p99 latency fell from 5.7 s to 469 ms"}
